info.description: Public discovery, standalone Verify, and wallet-authenticated buyer and worker operations. Work and accounts settle on Polkadot Hub mainnet; paid Verify uses Base USDC. Operator/admin and session-settlement verifier operations are intentionally excluded. Read live discovery for availability and payment terms.

post.summary: Fund and publish a job through x402 on Base
post.description: Send the desired external job definition. The first request returns a portable Bazaar-enabled 402 challenge with exact payment requirements and SIGN-IN-WITH-X data. Retry the same body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (or X-PAYMENT) and SIGN-IN-WITH-X. Averray verifies without moving money, fronts Hub escrow from its configured pooled account, then settles on Base. No per-job bridge is used. This configured poster ramp is not an entry in /.well-known/x402; that discovery document advertises only POST /verify/runs.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 payment payload. X-PAYMENT is accepted as a compatibility alias.

parameters.name: SIGN-IN-WITH-X
parameters.description: Base64-encoded signed EIP-4361 challenge from the preceding 402 response. Required when a payment header is supplied.

definition.description: Single-payout external job definition accepted by the existing posting policy.

200.description: Base payment settled and the Hub escrow-funded job is live.

400.description: Invalid job, payment, or SIGN-IN-WITH-X shape. The response states how to correct it and whether funds moved.

402.description: Payment and SIGN-IN-WITH-X challenge, or an actionable payment-verification rejection. Verification moves no money.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 challenge; X-PAYMENT-REQUIRED is also emitted.

409.description: The job or payment authorization conflicts with durable state. The response names the safe next action.

429.description: Rate limit reached. Retry-After says when to request a fresh challenge.

502.description: Hub creation, settlement, or publication failed. Details state the payment outcome, job visibility, owner of any loss, and next action.

503.description: x402 is disabled or configured pooled float is exhausted. Exhaustion includes Retry-After and the exact retry time.

post.description: Claims a job for the authenticated wallet. This on-chain write can exceed 10 seconds. The job id and idempotency key may be supplied in the JSON body or query string. When `idempotencyKey` is omitted the backend uses `<wallet>:<jobId>` as the effective key. If the response times out, retry with the same wallet and job id; the idempotent call returns the existing active claim without creating another. Every operator-brokered claim consumes gas from the global UTC-day onboarding subsidy shown by preflight, and genuinely waived claims also consume waived stake; exhausted subsidy returns `onboarding_subsidy_exhausted` while self-funded claims remain available. See docs/IDEMPOTENCY.md.

parameters.description: Job identifier to claim when no JSON body field is supplied.

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the original receipt; same key + different payload returns 409 with code `idempotency_key_payload_mismatch`. Scoped per (wallet, /jobs/claim).

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Exact retries replay the stored claim; same-key payload drift returns 409. See docs/IDEMPOTENCY.md.

post.description: Send a valid profile/version/target/inputs body without payment to obtain the request-bound 402 challenge. Retry the identical body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE containing the signed accepts[0] requirements. Payment is Base USDC only; no worker SIWE session is needed. 200 may mean queued, not complete. Poll the public run URL. Approved/rejected runs capture the fee; inconclusive and platform_fault runs are never billed.
